name: Spire Apex FC
description: Spire Apex FC is the IRONWALL LEAGUE's only Tier 5-affiliated team, founded in 2205 as a vanity project of the Sable Charter's entertainment division and playing home matches in the atmospheric Apex Arena suspended at the Spire's 140th floor. Their roster consists exclusively of athletes with top-tier military-adjacent augmentation, recruited globally, and their match-day experience is a luxury product as much as a sporting event — augmented reality overlays, neural-broadcast seating, and champagne derived from actual fermented grape.
story_hooks: A referee who participated in the 2219 fixing scheme wants to come forward, but Sable Charter's security division is watching their every move.
An Apex player suffers catastrophic augmentation failure during a match — and the post-incident investigation suggests their chrome was deliberately sabotaged.
A Tier 2 journalist is given exclusive access to Apex FC's training facility by a whistleblower inside the club, and what they find goes far beyond sports corruption.
